personality_one_liner: A highly readable, operational field-sales tool that uses tonal surfaces and clear hierarchy to make high-speed order booking and beat planning effortless in outdoor environments.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets (min 48pt for primary actions). Use md/lg spacing between cards. Strict adherence to safe areas.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary with borderStrong for elevation.
Ensure maximum readability in bright sunlight by avoiding blur in this utility context.
dont's: No frosted glass or blur effects; prioritize performance and offline utility for field force.

screens.name: Login

states.error: Inline text below input for invalid credentials.

screens.layout: Large brand logo at top. Single column, large input fields for Employee ID and Password. Sticky 'Login' primary CTA at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: At-a-glance performance overview and quick entry points for the day.

states.error: Snackbar 'Failed to sync data' + Retry icon.

screens.layout: Greeting header. 'Daily Performance' section (grid of tonal cards: Target, Sales, Visits). 'Quick Actions' row (pill buttons for New Visit, Order, Add Retailer). 'Today's Beat' preview list below. Tonal hierarchy rather than deep shadows.

screens.name: Beat Plan
screens.purpose: Sequential route execution and store visit tracking.

states.empty: Illustration + 'No retailers assigned today. Enjoy your rest!'

screens.layout: Sticky header with Date and 'Map View' toggle. List of retailers sorted by sequence. Each row shows Name, Distance, Status Badge (Pending/Visited), and a quick 'Start Visit' icon button.

screens.name: Retailer Profile
screens.purpose: Store intelligence and primary hub for store-level actions.
screens.layout: Cover image (store photo) with gradient scrim + Title overlay. Stats row (Outstanding, Last Order). Grid of large functional touch targets: START VISIT, PLACE ORDER, COLLECT PAYMENT. Scrollable history below.

screens.name: Order Booking
screens.purpose: High-speed catalog entry for product orders.
screens.layout: Sticky category filter tabs (brandTertiary chips). Scrollable list of products. Each row has product name, pack size, rate, and a large +/- stepper. Sticky bottom bar showing 'Net Value (₹)' and 'Place Order' CTA.

screens.name: Payment Collection
screens.purpose: Record received payments and upload receipt.
screens.layout: Form layout. Top card showing 'Outstanding Balance (₹)'. Input for 'Amount', dropdown for 'Mode' (Cash/Cheque/UPI). 'Upload Photo' dashed container. Sticky 'Record Payment' CTA.

home_header_bg.alt: Abstract subtle gradient overlay of an Indian retail shop

empty_beat_illustration.alt: Smiling shopkeeper indicating a good day

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow 2 Material You (Utility-Focused Variant) strictly. Use tonal layering (surface, surfaceSecondary, surfaceTertiary) without heavy drop shadows.
BANNED COLORS: Strictly avoid Indigo, Purple, Violet, Orange, Terracotta, Navy, Royal Blue. Use the defined Forest Green (#0F5A3E) as the brand primary.
Form inputs must be large (min 48pt height) to accommodate thick fingers in field scenarios.
All monetary values MUST use the Indian Rupee symbol (₹) formatting (e.g., ₹20,000).
Use a gradient scrim (top to bottom, transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse) whenever rendering text over an image (e.g., Retailer Profile Cover).
Ensure 'Order Booking' list items contain an inline stepper (+/-) and auto-calculates total in a sticky bottom container.
Disable glassmorphism/blur; field apps require high contrast, solid backgrounds, and maximum performance for low-end devices.
Implement bottom navigation with 5 items: HOME, BEAT, ORDERS, RETAILERS, MORE.
